context: Extend the existing dev-loop-metrics script rather than adding a new tool; use gh/GitHub API run history keyed by head branch; snapshot to _project/analysis/ci-failure-baseline-<date>.md with the exact query commands recorded for reproducibility.
description:
WS9 of _project/planning/ci-failure-reduction-plan.md (branch claude/ci-failures-merge-blockers-sitg7a). Because every dev PR lands via squash auto-merge once green, head-SHA check runs are green by construction; the real failure cost is fix-forward pushes, guard-file conflicts, and post-merge develop breaks. Before landing WS1-WS4 we need a baseline so a 2-week review can arbitrate outcomes (especially whether the merge-queue trial tracked by dev-loop-step-6-queue-decision-gate is justified).

Extend `make dev-loop-metrics` to compute, per merged develop PR over a trailing window: (a) pushes-after-open (fix-forward count, via commits on the head branch after PR open); (b) open-to-merge wall time; (c) whether _project/config/fast_test_lane_policy.json was touched; (d) first-pass required-lane green rate, derived from Actions run history per head branch (NOT head-SHA check runs, which are always green). Capture a dated baseline snapshot under _project/analysis/.

anti_patterns.dont: Derive first-pass green rate from head-SHA check runs
anti_patterns.instead: Use Actions workflow-run history per head branch across all pushes
anti_patterns.why: Auto-merge guarantees heads are green, so that measure reads 100% and hides every fix-forward round trip

preserves.behavior: Existing dev-loop-metrics output fields and their meanings (additive change only)
No new required CI check is introduced by this item

verifications.description: dev-loop-metrics runs clean with the new fields
verifications.expected: exit 0, new per-PR fields present in output

work_units.summary: Re-validate evidence: confirm squash-auto-merge policy and green-at-head behavior still hold on current develop (re-run the head-SHA check-run sample on 5 recent PRs)
Extend dev-loop-metrics with the four per-PR measures (fix-forward pushes, open-to-merge time, policy-file touch, first-pass green rate)
Capture and commit the dated baseline snapshot for the trailing 4 weeks
Document the 2-week re-measure cadence and decision hooks (WS1-WS4 effectiveness, merge-queue justification) in the snapshot header
